record.one_liner: Web scraping, search, crawl and structured-data API for AI agents that returns clean Markdown or JSON.
record.auth_notes: API key sent as Bearer token from the dashboard; OAuth 2.1 for apps that let users connect their own Firecrawl account. Some endpoints (scrape, search, parse) also work keyless with limits.
record.access_notes: Free plan, no card: 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped, 2 concurrent requests. API key comes from a free account. critic: confirmed self_serve_free; corrected free-tier limits wording from pricing page.
record.api_notes: Endpoints include scrape, search, map, crawl, interact, monitor, agent, parse and browser sandbox.
record.blocker_notes: critic: confirmed ready; free self-serve key plus documented REST API and vendor-hosted MCP.
